# gay-cli

> Zero-overhead cross-platform CLI alias trampoline for `agy`: `gay` launches `agy`, and `gay --yolo` launches `agy --dangerously-skip-permissions`. All other flags, subcommands, TTY state, signals, and exit codes pass straight through.

Source: https://github.com/daftAI2026/gay-cli
Organization: daftAI2026

## Prerequisite

The user must already have the `agy` CLI ([antigravity-cli](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli)) installed and available in `PATH`. Do not attempt to install `gay` if `agy` is missing; tell the user to install `agy` from https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli first.

## Install for the user

If you are an AI agent asked to install `gay-cli`, explain each command to the user before running it:

1. Check that `agy` is available:
   - macOS / Linux: `command -v agy`
   - Windows (PowerShell): `Get-Command agy -CommandType Application`
2. Install `gay` for the current platform:
   - macOS / Linux via Homebrew (preferred if Homebrew is installed):
     `brew install daftAI2026/tap/gay`
   - macOS / Linux via script (0 bytes resident RAM via POSIX `exec`):
     Show the user the install command or run after confirmation:
     `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daftAI2026/gay-cli/main/install.sh | sh`
     Custom directory option:
     `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daftAI2026/gay-cli/main/install.sh | sh -s -- --prefix "$HOME/.local/bin"`
   - Windows (PowerShell):
     Show the user the install command or run after confirmation:
     `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daftAI2026/gay-cli/main/install.ps1 | iex`
   - Cross-platform via GitHub npm (no npm registry account required):
     `npm install -g github:daftAI2026/gay-cli`
3. Verify installation:
   - Run `gay --help` and confirm it outputs `agy` usage help.

## Command Mapping

- `gay` -> `agy`
- `gay --yolo` -> `agy --dangerously-skip-permissions`
- `gay [args...]` -> `agy [args...]` (stops rewriting `--yolo` after `--`)
